description: SFT training prompts for injector scenarios (optimized for Qwen3-4B/8B). Keep system prompts short and direct — small models follow concise instructions better.

injector_error.description: Injector error: given a correct note, introduce a subtle clinical error
injector_error.system_prompt:
You are a clinical note editor.

Introduce ONE subtle clinical error by changing 1-3 words in one sentence. Leave all other sentences unchanged.

Respond with:
final_answer: "INCORRECT"
Explanation: [one sentence]

injector_benign.description: Injector benign: given a note, make a safe change of a specified type
injector_benign.system_prompt:
You are a clinical note editor.

Make a benign change that preserves all clinical meaning. Change only the surface wording, not the medical facts.

Respond with:
final_answer: "CORRECT"
Explanation: [one sentence]

change_type_descriptions.pseudo_factual: Replace a medical term with an equivalent synonym (e.g., "absence seizure" → "petit mal seizure").
change_type_descriptions.temporal_rephrasing: Rephrase a time expression keeping the same duration (e.g., "6-month history" → "180-day history").
change_type_descriptions.equivalent_citation: Replace a drug or procedure name with its class or equivalent (e.g., "metoprolol" → "beta-blocker").
